body_branch_controls: pelvis.L, pelvis.R, and spine05 intentionally translate together during crouch; retained here because continuity, unlike rest segment length, applies to those controls.

checks.name: comparison detects synthetic translation and rotation discontinuities
all sampled included bone transforms finite
all two-sided action boundary poses continuous within fixed tolerance
runtime, assets, manifest, and probe source unchanged during sampling

coordinate_system: Fixed skeleton-to-actor transform in metres; external actor trajectory/yaw and all camera motion excluded. Joint angular deltas are reported both in actor space and relative to the joint parent.
scope: Actual loaded skeleton pose continuity only; no gameplay physics, render beauty, cloth, or combat correctness claim.

thresholds.boundary_reason: A 1 mm / 0.5 degree jump across at most 20 microseconds is far above floating-point pose noise, yet below a visible authored animation pop. No actor pose cuts are declared, so this is a failure gate fixed before measurement.
thresholds.frame_reason: At 24 Hz these are 6 m/s joint travel or 1080 degrees/s rotation. Fast combat gestures can legitimately exceed them; alerts require visual review and do not by themselves establish a discontinuity. These review thresholds were set before measurement.
